scope: Word style metrics (styles.xml docDefaults, paragraph/table styles, page margins) applied to layout and pagination

implementation.styles: word-styles.ts parses w:docDefaults and paragraph/table styles with basedOn chains into resolved font size, font family, line spacing, space before/after, alignment and indent
implementation.paragraphs: parseParagraph resolves the paragraph style (default Normal) and merges table-style metrics for cell paragraphs; direct pPr/rPr still wins
implementation.tableStyles: Tables read w:tblStyle (TableGrid etc.); TableGrid resolves to 10pt Times, single line (1.0 x 1.15), space-after 0
implementation.lineHeight: Word auto line spacing (w:line/240 of single) is rendered as multiplier x 1.15 single-line factor
implementation.margins: w:pgMar is parsed into pageMargins and used for pagination content height and page padding; real doc top 96 / bottom 66.2 / left 96 / right 60
implementation.tables: w:tblGrid fixes column widths (from earlier task) and cell vertical padding is 0
